pricing.basis: Global standard text list price; includes thinking tokens; ignores cache discounts. Token-based estimate, not a billing invoice.

semanticControl: Both arms receive identical cached per-document LLM extractions after retrieving that document. Each arm is costed as if it paid for every reader call. The cache is private and cannot disclose unqueried documents.
decision: Do not claim agent benefit unless quality and useful coverage match the fixed-reader arm and equivalent machine cost falls. Human time and production PayPal benefit remain unmeasured.
limitations: Ten known development cases; no independent validation or holdout claim.
Two trials per case are a pilot, not a reliability estimate.
Fixed normalized reference uses authored extraction and is not an end-to-end competitor.
Physical wall times are not fair latency comparisons because the second arm reuses reader outputs.
